comparisons.peer_summary: The Firmwide Data Governance Committee, co-chaired by the chief information officer and chief risk officer, oversees the firmwide data governance framework and data quality implementation.
comparisons.comparison: Both Citi and Goldman Sachs disclosed specific governance structures addressing data quality and governance. Citi explicitly stated it modified its data program governance structure and increased investment in response to regulatory findings. Similarly, GS described a 'Firmwide Data Governance Committee' that oversees the data governance framework and data quality implementation, co-chaired by the CIO and CRO. While Citi focused on the structural changes and investment post-regulatory findings, GS detailed the ongoing committee-based oversight mechanism for data quality.

sentences.text: As a result, Citi has made changes to its governance and structure of its data program as well as increased the level of investment in the program.

The Firmwide Data Governance Committee is responsible for overseeing the firmwide data governance framework, and its implementation, to help ensure that data governance and data quality are appropriate. This committee is co-chaired by our chief information officer and our chief risk officer, who are appointed as chairs by the chairs of the Firmwide Enterprise Risk Committee.
